items.title: Integration risk with vs. without a translation layer
items.description: An illustrative model, not measured data: every downstream context wired directly to an upstream model risks breaking on every upstream change — so direct-wiring risk scales with the number of consumers. A shared anticorruption layer absorbs each upstream change once, regardless of how many downstream contexts depend on it. Drag 'downstream consumers' up and watch the gap between the two lines widen.
items.compute: const directRisk = params.numDownstreamConsumers * params.upstreamChangesPerQuarter; const aclRisk = params.upstreamChangesPerQuarter; return { directRisk, aclRisk };

outputs.label: Updates needed, with a shared layer
